note: Weekly target = August monthly GA4 target x 7/30. Vesu remains excluded (still closed, no bookings or Google spend). Hong Kong held its record level: 1,052 bookings against a 949 target (+10.9 percent), up +1.0 percent week on week and +12.3 percent year on year. Four venues beat target, led by Cantina (+102%), Shiro (+29%), The Chinese Library (+20%) and Hutong (+11%). Dim Sum Library (-14%) and Aqua HK (-5%) were the only misses, and they are the same two venues still behind on YTD (Aqua HK -6.7%, Dim Sum Library -7.2%); the other four are all double-digit percentages ahead. The portfolio is +6.3 percent ahead of its cumulative YTD target.
